title: Certificates of Deposit: Scope and Effect of Repointing an Interest Payout Account
content:
This page sets out, for Piedmont Crescent Bank's Certificates of Deposit, what the repointing of paid-out interest away from a closed account finally records, which certificates it leaves alone, and from when the change counts.

## What is recorded

For a certificate whose interest is paid out to a payout account that has been closed, the payout account on record becomes the replacement account: the owner's active account of the kind the interest is paid to, or, where the owner has none of that kind, the owner's active account of the other kind together with a switch of the interest setting to compounding.

Nothing is written for a certificate whose interest compounds, nor for one whose interest is paid to an account that is not closed. Their settings stay exactly as they are.

## Certificates left to the maturity instruction

Where the maturity instruction itself sends the balance out, to checking or to savings, and names that very closed account, this repointing stands aside. Its payout account is replaced along with its maturity instruction, and nothing is written under this repointing.

## When the change counts

A repointed interest setting governs interest from the next crediting date onward, as every change of interest setting does. An interest setting that pays out can be recorded only where the certificate's tier lists paying out among its interest choices.

## Truth table (hypothetical certificates)

| Interest setting | Payout account | Maturity instruction | What is written |
|---|---|---|---|
| Paid to savings | closed | renew automatically | the owner's replacement account on the interest setting |
| Paid to savings | closed | pay out to savings | nothing here; the account is replaced with the maturity instruction |
| Paid to checking | active | renew automatically | nothing |
| Compounding | closed | renew automatically | nothing |
| Paid to checking | closed | mail a check | the owner's replacement account on the interest setting |
